AI body insights (beta)

Your posture & proportion snapshot

Generated on your device from your photo using pose analysis — measuring alignment, symmetry and proportion, not judging your body. Use it as a gentle baseline for your coach to work from.

This is a wellness estimate generated from a single photo and your height, not a medical or diagnostic measurement. Actual body composition and change over time depend on many factors — your coach will confirm specifics with you directly.

Enter your details

BMI is a simple ratio of height to weight — it doesn't account for muscle, frame or fitness level. Your coach looks at the full picture, not just this number.

Optional — skip anytime

Want an AI body insights preview?

Upload a full-length photo (front-facing, standing, fitted clothing works best) and we'll analyse posture, symmetry and proportions right in your browser — about 30 data points your coach can use to personalise your plan further.
